reference_materials.limitation: General manufacturer post-level description, not a dimensioned 175-O engineering drawing

findings: The front view retains the two orange faces, waisted side cuts, upper and lower lips, three vial housings and hanging hole. The rectangular strap post is on the source-photo left and the small round peg on the right.
Original identification text remains readable on both faces. A reflection used in the first local candidate mirrored the second text surface; rotation now places that text without reflection.

The vial close-ups show transparent acrylic, a yellow liquid domain, a distinct gas cavity and visible rings. Inward cavity boundaries are retained; the checker detects filled chambers and checks signed boundary volumes.

The rear view exposes the source-based 90 degree contact faces and selected reflector backs. The detached rubber loop lies flat with a real central opening; its unstretched size and installed shape are hypotheses.
geometry_limits: General manufacturer educational dimensions constrain the outer envelope; the molded profiles, vial dimensions, markings and strap dimensions are not from manufacturer CAD.
Current gas placement is a static source-photo illustration, not a measurement. Gravity response, barrel curvature, menisci, optics, calibration and visual reading remain unimplemented.
The transparent rendering does not simulate refractive optics. Factory internal retention and strap tension are not qualified.
This ordinary tool candidate is not staged inventory, an installed level on the weather mast or a robot-executed adjustment.
